title: File:Serbian White Eagles 2007 cup match team photo by Djuradj Vujcic.jpg
desc:
Serbian White Eagles team prior to an Open Canada Cup match in 2007. 

Top row, from left to right:
Aleksandar Krivokapić (assistant coach), Arthur Zaslavski, Uroš Stamatović, Gabriel Pop, Milan Janošević, Mirko Medić, Niki Budalic and Siniša Ninković (head coach). 

Bottom row:

Osni Neto, Alex Bra

title: File:Serbian White Eagles 2008 celebration - photo by Vujcic.jpg
desc: The Serbian White Eagles players and supporters celebrate after winning in the 2008 Canadian Soccer League championship final. People with Wikipedia articles have been tagged.
